music.title: Valandy

empty.title: Your library is empty
empty.hint: Add the folder where you keep your music.

music.queue-empty: Nothing in the queue. Play an album or a song to start.

settings.title: Settings

scan-on-start.name: Look for changes on start
scan-on-start.hint: Read new or changed files in your folders every time Valandy opens.

rebuild.name: Rebuild library
rebuild.hint: Forget the saved tags and covers and read every file again. Your music is not touched.

crossfade.name: Crossfade
crossfade.hint: Fade the end of a song into the start of the next one.

gapless.name: Gapless playback
gapless.hint: No silence between tracks of the same album (live albums, mixes).

replaygain.name: Volume normalization
replaygain.hint: Use the ReplayGain tags so songs play at a similar loudness.

resume.name: Resume the queue
resume.hint: When Valandy opens, the queue is where you left it (paused).

lyrics.hint: Where lyrics come from, in order of priority. The first one that has the song's lyrics wins.

embedded.name: In the file
embedded.hint: Lyrics saved in the song's tags.

local.name: .lrc file
local.hint: A .lrc or .txt file with the same name, next to the song.

online.name: LRCLIB (internet)
online.hint: Free lyrics database, with synced lyrics for many songs.

prefer-synced.name: Prefer synced lyrics
prefer-synced.hint: If the first lyrics found are not synced, keep looking in the next sources.

covers.hint: Where covers come from, in order of priority.

embedded.name: In the file
embedded.hint: The picture saved in the song's tags.

local.name: Folder image
local.hint: cover.jpg, folder.jpg or front.jpg next to the songs.

download.name: Download missing covers
download.hint: Look up albums and songs without a cover on MusicBrainz and the Cover Art Archive.

settings.privacy: Searches on the internet send only the artist, album and song name. Lyrics and covers stay saved on your computer.

equalizer.name: Equalizer
equalizer.hint: Adjust bass, mids and treble across 10 bands.

eq-preset.name: Preset
eq-preset.hint: Moving a band by hand switches to “Custom”.

playlist.name: Playlist name
playlist.empty: This playlist is empty. Right-click a song and choose «Add to» to add it.
playlist.empty-favorites: Songs you like show up here. Tap the heart on any song.

servers.title: Servers
servers.hint: Stream from your own Jellyfin or Subsonic server (Navidrome, Gonic, Airsonic…). Its songs join your library; the music is not downloaded. Passwords and tokens are kept in the system keyring.
servers.name: Name (optional)
servers.missing: Write the address and the user.
servers.unreachable: The server could not be reached. Check the address and your connection.
